items.summary: Carolina Reis de Oliveira on Reversing Skin Age, Menopause, GLP-1 Skin, and the Science of Senescent Cells For Dave’s listeners only, visit oneskin.co/Dave for exclusive early access to the OS-01 Face Rich Cream! Host Dave Asprey sits down with Carolina Reis de Oliveira, PhD, CEO and co-founder of OneSkin. Carolina holds a PhD in stem cell biology and tissue engineering, is a co-inventor of five patents, and has co-authored numerous scientific publications. She and her team are studying skin longevity by targeting one of the central drivers of aging: the accumulation of senescent cells. They break down why skin loses its ability to hold water as you age, and why that process can accelerate dramatically during perimenopause and menopause. Carolina explains the skin's "brick and mortar" barrier system, how declining estrogen affects collagen, ceramides, cholesterol, hyaluronic acid, and elastin, and why simply sealing moisture into your skin with occlusive products does not solve the underlying biology. They also explore why GLP-1 users can experience loose or sagging skin after rapid weight loss and what may help preserve skin structure over time. Carolina reveals how her team screened hundreds of peptides to develop OS-01, a senomorphic peptide designed to reduce the damaging signals produced by senescent "zombie" cells while supporting healthier skin function. In their research, OS-01 reduced markers of cellular senescence and inflammation, increased collagen production…

items.title: They Lab Tested Retatrutide — The Results Were Shocking
items.summary: Are you actually getting the peptide you paid for? In this Peptide A to Z investigation, we look at independent laboratory testing of peptide products labeled Retatrutide and NAD+ that were purchased over the counter from a Brooklyn smoke shop. Four sealed vials were tested. Two were labeled Retatrutide 10mg. Two were labeled NAD+ 500mg. 🧬 FREE PEPTIDE GUIDE: Get the Peptide A to Z Guide and learn the basics of peptides, research, terminology, and more: PeptideAtoZ.com 👥 JOIN THE PEPTIDE A TO Z COMMUNITY: Connect with others interested in peptide research, longevity, and the latest peptide science: PeptideAtoZ.com According to the reported laboratory results, none of the four samples could be positively identified as the substance stated on the label. The retatrutide samples also produced an unexpected signal that the laboratory described as suggesting “extreme contamination.” But the story gets even more concerning. CBS News separately investigated a certificate of analysis associated with the retatrutide product. The laboratory named on that certificate reportedly told CBS that it never issued the certificate and had never had the company as a client. items.title: Thymosin Alpha-1 may be one of the most studied peptides you’ve never heard of.
items.summary: While many popular peptides have limited human evidence, Thymosin Alpha-1 has been investigated across 30+ clinical studies involving more than 11,000 human subjects. Researchers have explored its effects on the immune system, serious infections, cancer, and other immune-related conditions. But one of the largest trials produced a surprising result. items.summary: Hi HN, I’m Lloyd, one of two founders of RonanRx ( https://ronanrx.com/ ). We are building a vertically integrated pharmaceutical company with software for prescribing, telehealth, compounding, manufacturing, and delivery. We are starting with GLP-1s and peptides. The path to RonanRx is fairly unconventional. During the pandemic, I built one of the largest mask manufacturing factories in the US. We could make a million masks in a day. We converted raw polypropylene pellets into finished pallets of masks. I had a background in software from my YC W10 company, so we took a software approach to building our factory. We used machine learning and computer vision to optimize production. We also vertically integrated almost everything. It worked. We built an efficient manufacturing operation and grew the business to 50 million dollars in revenue. Then people actually stopped caring about masks. Fair enough. Around the same time, I decided to try and lose the weight I had gained while building the factory. I ate nothing but chicken for six months. While this diet got some results, I plateaued. My doctor suggested tirzepatide, a GLP-1 medication. For me, losing weight was only the beginning. "Food noise" was gone. I showed less interest in other compulsive behavior. I stopped scrolling Instagram and quit biting my nails. But that was just the beginning. I was born with a congenital heart defect called aortic stenosis. items.title: The Peptide That Actually Builds Bone? 65% Lower Fracture Risk
items.summary: Can a peptide actually BUILD new bone? Forteo, also known as teriparatide, is an FDA-approved peptide medicine with something most peptides discussed online don't have: large human trials and evidence showing fewer fractures. In this video, we break down how Forteo works, why it can stimulate new bone formation, and the major human trial where the standard dose was associated with about a 65% lower relative risk of new spinal fractures compared with placebo. We also look at one of the most fascinating parts of its history: early animal studies raised concerns about bone tumors, Forteo originally carried an FDA boxed warning, and years of human safety evidence eventually led the FDA to remove that boxed warning. This is a perfect example of why the question isn't simply “Do peptides work?” The better question is: Which peptide, for what purpose, and where is the human evidence? 📘 FREE Peptide Guide: PeptideAtoZ.com/free-guide 💬 Join the Peptide A to Z Community: PeptideAtoZ.com/community 🔬 Peptide A to Z Research.
